Available July · Student Property · Great Location

Acorn Properties are pleased to market this seven bedroom student property in the heart of Jesmond. Impressive property close to local bars, shops and short walk to Newcastle and Northumbria University. The property comprises of large reception room and separate dining room area, four bathrooms, and 7 double bedrooms and large family a sized kitchen with washer dryer and a dishwasher. The property also has added bonus of outdoor space. To arrange your viewing contact Acorn Properties and speak to the Lettings Team.
